sources.retrieval: Direct official NFL report, measurement paragraph and official sprint result
sources.cohort: One selected prospect; not population prevalence
sources.allowedUse: Dated measurement/performance regression fixture; preserve a compatible fast athlete at this mass
limitations: No race or natural appearance inference
No distribution fit or career development rates

sources.retrieval: Direct official NFL report, guard and center sections
sources.cohort: Two editorially selected prospects; not representative sampling
sources.allowedUse: Partial dated regression inputs; unknown stature must remain unobserved, with any fixture completion explicitly estimated
limitations: Unknown stature/segment dimensions in extracted records
No mass-to-speed regression, national frequency or racial classification

sources.retrieval: Primary research abstract indexed by PubMed search; direct PubMed and DOI full-page retrieval unsuccessful
sources.allowedUse: Research target for distinct sprint/jump capacities and method-aware positional covariance; no fitted coefficients
limitations: No endurance, reactive agility, appearance or anatomical shape fit

implementationDecisions.grooming: Current uniform eligible-style selection is an artistic prior. Define a dated nonduplicated NFL grooming sample with trait-level occlusion and unknowns before replacing it with observed weights.
implementationDecisions.body: Observed dimensions take precedence. Retain conflicts/residuals and estimates explicitly; incomplete reported dimensions cannot silently become observed values.
implementationDecisions.athleticism: Selected cases establish permitted test inputs, not their likelihood. Separate measured drills, evaluation ratings, fitted initial covariance and illustrative animation.
implementationDecisions.persistence: Version new generation and preserve existing player decoders, natural traits and measurement precision.
